pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Question: Will the pedestrian located at [400, 842, 515, 1133] in frame 1 cross the road? Justify your answer with spatial, temporal, mathematical, ego-vehicle, and scene-context reasoning. Conclude the pedestrian’s motives.

pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Conclusion: The pedestrian will not cross the road because they are walking steadily along the sidewalk parallel to traffic, showing no signs of crossing preparation, orientation toward the road, or interaction with the vehicle traffic flow.
